title: Fox Meets PRI Leader 'Alito' Moreno at Party Headquarters — Explores Opposition Alliance via 'Alma de México'
detail: Twenty-six years after his 2000 election ended 71 years of PRI rule, Vicente Fox visits PRI national headquarters in Mexico City to meet party leader Alejandro 'Alito' Moreno Cárdenas, parliamentary coordinators Manuel Añorve and Rubén Moreira, and members of the PRI's National Executive Committee. Fox attends with associates from Alma de México, the citizen platform he has used through 2026 to court political and civil-society actors, and the two sides discuss strengthening institutional checks and building a broader opposition front ahead of the 2027 midterm congressional elections. Neither side frames the meeting as an electoral pact, but the encounter — Fox's most visible engagement with the party he defeated in 2000 — draws immediate Morena backlash.
